summary: I opened package.json and requirements.txt. Both findings cite the right lines, quote them accurately, and are rated medium as the checklist says. I also found no package-lock.json, yarn.lock or constraints.txt. The only defect is a miscount in the summary.

challenges.claim: The summary says three runtime dependencies are unpinned, but it names only two (express and gunicorn), and only two findings exist.
challenges.rationale: package.json pins dayjs and lodash exactly, and only express is "*". requirements.txt pins Flask and requests and leaves only gunicorn open. That makes two unpinned dependencies, not three, so the summary contradicts both its own text and the findings.
